tests.name: Effective description
tests.message: Verdict not allowed for this test: 'warning' (allowed: passed, failed)

tests.name: Verbosity and conciseness
tests.reasoning: The body jumps straight into domain-specific semantics (ECR lifecycle policy evaluation, evidence tiers, push correlation) without explaining general concepts like what ECR or lifecycle policies are. It assumes the agent already knows AWS basics and focuses entirely on non-obvious, project-specific procedures.
tests.evidence: Answer one question precisely for an Amazon ECR repository: which images will the lifecycle policy remove at its next evaluation, and is any of them still in use or tagged as a release?

tests.name: Detailed reference materials must not be in body
tests.reasoning: Detailed reference data (full API error tables, simulation procedure details, report skeletons) is pushed into references/ files, and the body only contains condensed tables (permissions, verdict model, check matrix) that are core to every run rather than deep reference data stashed in conditional branches.
tests.evidence: [ecr-api-reference.md](references/ecr-api-reference.md): allowlist, hard denials, preview procedure, error classification, URI matching, source statuses, unverified facts. Load at Step 1.

tests.name: Reference files must be linked
tests.reasoning: All three reference files (ecr-api-reference.md, ecr-lifecycle-semantics.md, report-template.md) are linked via markdown links in the body.

tests.name: Reference links must specify when to load
tests.reasoning: Each reference link specifies when to load it (Step 1, Step 4, Step 6, Step 9) rather than a generic 'see for details' mention.
tests.evidence: Load at Step 1. ... Load at Step 4, or section 6 alone at Step 6 when CloudTrail returned events. ... loaded at Step 9

tests.name: Reference path format
tests.reasoning: All reference links use relative paths from the skill root in the form references/filename.md.

tests.name: Prescription vs description
tests.reasoning: Fragile operations (preview polling, push correlation rule, verdict assignment) are given exact prescriptive steps, while flexible areas (scope resolution, which repository to examine) are described with reasoning and defaults rather than rigid steps.
tests.evidence: A BatchGetImage, GetDownloadUrlForLayer, PutImage... event whose eventTime is within 60 seconds of that image's imagePushedAt is part of the push workflow and MUST NOT count as a consumer pull.

tests.name: Defaults, not menus
tests.reasoning: The skill designates a clear default (ECR's own preview) with an explicit fallback (deterministic simulation) rather than presenting multiple equal options.
tests.evidence: Preview is the source of truth. Try StartLifecyclePolicyPreview on every run. Only when it cannot complete, simulate, and label every number that came from the simulation SIMULATED.

tests.name: Favor procedures over declarations
tests.reasoning: The skill teaches a generalizable procedure (scope resolution, evidence hierarchy, verdict assignment, check matrix) applicable to any repository/policy combination, not a one-off declaration for a specific repo.
tests.evidence: Repository comes from the prompt. 'The account', 'all repos', 'every repository' means every repository returned by DescribeRepositories in the current Region.

tests.name: Gotchas section
tests.reasoning: The skill has an extensive 'Known Quirks' table documenting concrete, non-obvious environment-specific behaviors (push correlation false positives, preview expiration, permission gaps).
tests.evidence: An image push emits BatchGetImage (and layer events) 1 to 2 seconds after imagePushedAt, from the pushing principal (observed 2026-10-27 on 26 of 26 images) | The push correlation rule drops these events...

tests.name: Templates and outputs missing
tests.reasoning: The skill explicitly provides and references an output report template for its structured output.
tests.evidence: Render from [report-template.md](references/report-template.md), loaded at Step 9, with these ## headings in order: Scope, Repository Rating, Source of Truth...

tests.name: Templates and outputs must not be in body
tests.reasoning: The report template itself is stored in references/report-template.md and only linked/described in the body, not inlined as a large block; the body only shows the column list and heading order, not the full template.
tests.evidence: Expiring Images columns: Tags, Digest (first 12 hex characters), Pushed, Last recorded pull, Claimed by rule, Action, Verdict, Evidence.

tests.evidence: Self check before responding. The expiring image count must be identical in Scope, Source of Truth, Expiring Images and the Rule by Rule total. The Check Matrix has exactly 15 rows... If any of these fail, fix the report before sending.
